parts.label: Bottom hinge pivot
parts.description: Dark pivot element joining the two hinged hoop halves at the bottom seam.

parts.label: Left hoop half
parts.description: Curved polished metal half extending from the bottom hinge to the upper-left open end.

parts.label: Right hoop half
parts.description: Curved polished metal half extending from the bottom hinge to the upper-right clasp end.

parts.label: Clasp insert
parts.description: Small dark latch or receiving insert fitted into the upper terminal of the right hoop half.

parts.label: Engraved side pattern
parts.description: Repeated recessed decorative graphics along the outer-facing surface of the left hoop half.
